## What you want changed

The specific rule, gate, or behavior — quote the current text if it exists.

## Why

Most of this repo is deliberately-designed prose: mode ceremony levels, evidence gates by task size, the rule-of-three decision-log gate, and similar thresholds were picked for stated reasons (often "avoid the specific failure mode this replaced"). A proposal that doesn't touch the underlying rationale is more likely to get re-litigated later — explain what's not working about the current behavior, not just what you'd prefer.

## What else this touches

Rules in this repo are often stated in more than one place (a mode's table, the owning skill, `AGENTS.md`'s quick-reference, `README.md`). List every file you know references the thing you're proposing to change, so the review can check all of them get updated together, not just the first one you found.

## Alternatives considered

If you looked at other ways to solve the same problem, what were they and why didn't you pick them.
